text: Spray the chain with the recommended chain cleaning solvent while you turn the rear wheel. Make sure the whole chain is covered with the solvent, and use a suitable brush on hard deposits if needed. Wait a few minutes, then clean the chain thoroughly to remove dirt and grime. Turn the rear wheel slowly and apply the recommended chain lubricant to the chain links. After a few minutes, wipe off the excess lubricant with a clean cloth. The manual schedules cleaning, lubricating and adjusting the chain every 500 km (or earlier as required), or after riding in wet, dusty or muddy conditions. The manual does not name a specific chain cleaner or chain lubricant; it refers to the recommended ones.
